LEFT JOIN public_spot_detail d ON d.spot_id = s.id

mapper.sql:
WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.latitude BETWEEN #{area.swLat} AND #{area.neLat} AND s.longitude BETWEEN #{area.swLng} AND #{area.neLng}
AND s.type IN
#{type}
AND (s.type <> 'BAKJI' OR b.has_water = TRUE)
AND (s.type <> 'BAKJI' OR b.has_toilet = TRUE)
AND s.park_warning = FALSE
AND NOT ( s.type <> 'BAKJI' AND ( ((d.closed_from IS NOT NULL OR d.closed_until IS NOT NULL) AND (d.closed_from IS NULL OR d.closed_from <= #{area.today}) AND (d.closed_until IS NULL OR d.closed_until >= #{area.today})) OR (d.closed_from IS NULL AND d.closed_until IS NULL AND d.operating_status IS NOT NULL AND d.operating_status IN ('TEMPORARILY_CLOSED', 'PERMANENTLY_CLOSED'))))
mapper.select:
SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(optimizer_switch = 'prefer_ordering_index=off') */ m.spot_id AS spot_id, m.type AS type, m.name AS name, m.lat AS lat, m.lng AS lng, m.park_warning AS park_warning, pd.operating_status AS operating_status, pd.closed_from AS closed_from, pd.closed_until AS closed_until FROM ( SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.type AS type, s.name AS name, s.latitude AS lat, s.longitude AS lng, s.park_warning AS park_warning FROM spot s
ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit} ) m LEFT JOIN public_spot_detail pd ON pd.spot_id = m.spot_id ORDER BY m.spot_id

SELECT AVG(c.lat) AS lat, AVG(c.lng) AS lng, COUNT(*) AS spot_count FROM ( SELECT s.latitude AS lat, s.longitude AS lng, LEAST(FLOOR((s.latitude - #{area.swLat}) / #{grid.cellLat}), #{grid.lastCellIndex}) AS cell_row, LEAST(FLOOR((s.longitude - #{area.swLng}) / #{grid.cellLng}), #{grid.lastCellIndex}) AS cell_column FROM spot s
) c GROUP BY c.cell_row, c.cell_column ORDER BY c.cell_row, c.cell_column
